title: Aoyagi Toya — Fear That I've Felt〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Cafe

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can see why you recommended this cafe so much, Azusawa. This place has a nice atmosphere to it.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
And it feels so trendy!
I'm glad we came! This feels like the perfect place for us to take our break!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that you guys like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, this place's deluxe strawberry coffee's supposed to be really good, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, that's right! It was very good when I had it. They make it using a generous helping of real strawberries.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Interesting. That explains all the strawberries I saw in those photos. Also, Mita, it says here that the owner's family runs a strawberry farm...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Really?! Now I'm getting jealous...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But it looks awfully sweet...
As curious as I am about it, I sort of wondering whether or not I should just order their regular coffee...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, actually!
You can order one to make it not too sweet.

rows.Speaker: Barista
rows.Line: I can help whoever's next here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, that register's open.
Let's go order!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: O-Okay...
se_walk_men_002_1
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Barista
rows.Line:
Welcome!
What can I get for you today?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, I'd like...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A skinny deluxe strawberry coffee with white chocolate chips, please. Double whip, double vanilla.

rows.Speaker: Toya & Kotaro
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Wh-What did she just say...?
Was that her order...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, umm... I ordered their deluxe strawberry coffee with white chocolate chips as a topping.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Some extra whipped cream and vanilla as well. Also, I asked for them to use fat-free milk instead.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ah, I see...
I think I have a better understanding now.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: What...? After just that explanation?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
I understood all those words separately, but I couldn't imagine what sort of drink they referred to.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That being said... It may not be the best idea for me to repeat what she said due to my dislike of sugary things.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, Azusawa, I'm sorry, but would you mind giving me a recommendation?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, okay! Let's see...
Since you're looking for something unsweetened, then I suggest asking for “no syrup, no whip”.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, to take out the syrup and whipped cream.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Exactly! Also, you could ask for extra espresso if you want to enjoy the taste of their coffee more.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm not sure how much you should add. It might be good to ask them about that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay, thank you...
I'll try ordering that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Excuse me. I'm ready to order.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like your deluxe strawberry coffee, please. No syrup, no whip. Some extra espresso as well, but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How much would you recommend putting in? I'm actually not all that fond of sugary drinks, and I was hoping to enjoy the taste of your coffee...

rows.Speaker: Barista
rows.Line:
Got it.
In that case, I'd recommend three shots. That should allow you to enjoy both the strawberries and coffee at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, three shots it is.

rows.Speaker: Barista
rows.Line: Okay, it'll be right out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was able to give them my order. Thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Congratulations, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
That was amazing!
Alright, now I've gotta get my order right...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Mind lending me a hand, Azusawa...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure. So, Mita, since you like strawberries so much...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, this is very good.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: On top of it being not too sweet, the rich taste of this coffee matches these strawberries incredibly well.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Yeah, and these strawberries are so fresh!
Thanks for letting us know about this place, Azusawa!!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Yes, this is delicious...
But I'm still astonished by the fact that I was able to get my order in properly.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I feel like I've taken another step forward by experiencing something new.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I'm glad you guys are enjoying this so much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, but our break's almost over.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You're right.
We can finish these once we've met back up with the others.
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, welcome back!
Looks like you three got your drinks!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Mita...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You had them swap out the dark chocolate chips for white ones, huh? A lot of people have been doing that, but they are pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Huh?! Y-Yeah, they are...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane, extra whipped cream as usual?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Did you get extra espresso with yours, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You too, Ken...?!
Also, how did you two know what we ordered just by looking...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...?
I mean, we've been to that place a bunch of times already.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: These three asked me to guess what you'd order, Toya. I figured that that would be what you'd go for.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The fact that you've all visited that cafe multiple times already is astonishing to me. I still can't believe that I managed to get my order right...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
But we just gotta remember what we did!
We shouldn't forget about what we experienced today!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Because there's still more to come up ahead...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
We need to keep our wits sharp.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I believe in you, Aoyagi, Mita!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Aren't you guys blowing things a bit out of proportion?
